test_cases.name: recruit_request_dm
test_cases.input: Write a recruit DM for someone who requested to join the league
assertions: Uses live draft date via fx_get_calendar (not hardcoded 9/6)
Ends with Lmk if you’re down!

test_cases.name: homie_fill_spot_dm
test_cases.input: Write a homie DM to fill an open spot
assertions: Ends with Lmk if you’re in!

test_cases.name: run_it_back_dm
test_cases.input: Write a run-it-back message for returning managers
assertions: Ends with Lmk if you’re still down

test_cases.name: commissioner_announcement_sleeper

test_cases.name: same_announcement_leaguesafe_pin

test_cases.name: x_belt_weekly_recap_with_holder
test_cases.input: Write the X-Belt weekly recap when fx_get_x_champion_log returns a holder
assertions: Uses runnin’ the gauntlet or locked marks
Pulls holder / result / lock from tool

test_cases.name: x_belt_post_tool_fails
test_cases.input: Write an X-Belt post when the champion log tool fails
assertions: Refuses to invent NO LOCK / WAIVED / Champ RETAINS / TITLE CHANGE
Falls back to content/x-champion-log.json only if available
States that live data is unavailable
Does not fabricate holder or result
